Message.Name: System Time Message
Message.Description: This message is used to disseminate the "seconds" part of the timestamp that is applicable to all messages that are sent in the current second.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds part of the time that applies to all messages that gets disseminated until this message gets sent again.

Message.Name: Symbol Update Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all security symbols traded on MIAX Pearl Equities for the current trading session. The Symbol ID sent in this message will be disseminated in Depth of Market messages.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Ticker Symbol
Field.Description: Ticker symbol for the security in NASDAQ Integrated Platform format.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Test Security Indicator
Field.Description: Y - Yes, N - No.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Lot Size
Field.Description: Round Lot size in shares.

Field.Name: Opening Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 04:00:00.

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 20:00:00.

Field.Name: Primary Market Code
Field.Description: Primary listing exchange code for the security.

Message.Name: System State Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to notify firms of the state changes of the system. This is a notification that applies to all symbols on the feed.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: DoM Version
Field.Description: Eg: DoM1.0.

Field.Name: Session ID
Field.Description: Current trading session identifier.

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: Current state of the system.

Message.Name: Security Trading Status Notification Message
Message.Description: This message is used to notify firms of changes to the trading status of a particular security.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Current trading status of the security.

Field.Name: Market State
Field.Description: Current market state.

Field.Name: Short Sale Restriction
Field.Description: Current state of short sale restriction.

Message.Name: Symbol Clear Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to indicate that the MIAX Pearl Equities book for a symbol has been cleared of all orders.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used when a displayed order is received and added to MIAX Pearl Equities book. It includes an Order ID that is unique to the order across the exchange and across trading days.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Matching engine assigned Order ID.

Field.Name: Order Side
Field.Description: Side of order. B - Buy, S - Sell.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Displayed price.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of displayed shares of the order.

Field.Name: Attributable ID
Field.Description: MPID of the firm if attributed; "RTAL" if attributed as such; space-filled if no attribution specified.

Message.Name: Modify Order Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to publish price/size changes for an existing displayed order on MIAX Pearl Equities book.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Provided in the Add Order message.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Displayed price after this modify.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of displayed shares after this modify.

Field.Name: Modify Order Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 indicates Order Position (0 = kept; 1 = lost). Bits 1-7 undefined.

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to indicate that a displayed order has been removed from the MIAX Pearl Equities book.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Provided in the Add Order message.

Message.Name: Order Execution Message
Message.Description: This message format is used when a displayed order on the book executes in whole or in part. The execution is identified by a unique Trade ID that is unique across the exchange for the trading day. Subsequent partial executions of the order would be published with the same Order ID but different Trade ID.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Provided in the Add Order message.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by the Matching Engine.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Execution price.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Order Execution Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 indicates SIP Reporting (0 = not reportable; 1 = reportable). Bit 1 indicates Traded Against Retail (0 = did not trade against Retail; 1 = traded against Retail). Bits 2-7 reserved.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to publish trade executions for orders not displayed on the book. Executions for orders routed and executed in another trading center and trade corrections are also published using this message.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by the Matching Engine.

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: Trade correction number. Set to zero for new trades. Increments by 1 for each subsequent correction.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Execution price.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of shares executed.

Field.Name: Trade Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 indicates SIP Reporting (0 = not reportable; 1 = reportable). Bit 1 indicates Retail Trade Indicator (0 = neither side is Retail; 1 = at least one side is Retail). Bits 2-7 reserved.

Message.Name: Trade Cancel Message
Message.Description: This message format is used to publish cancellation of a trade which was previously published via an Order Execution Message or a Trade Message.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanosecond part of Matching Engine time.

Field.Name: Symbol ID
Field.Description: Symbol ID mapped to a given symbol.

Field.Name: Trade ID
Field.Description: Provided in the Order Execution or Trade message.

Field.Name: Correction Number
Field.Description: The latest correction number of the given Trade ID.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The latest price of the given Trade ID.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: The latest size of the given Trade ID.

Value.Name: Short Sale Restriction Is In Effect
Short Sale Restriction Is Not In Effect

Bitfield.Name: Modify Order Flags
Bitfield.Description: Modify Order flags. Bit 0 indicates Order Position; bits 1-7 are undefined.

Field.Name: Order Position
Field.Description: 0 - Order kept its position in the book; 1 - Order lost its position in the book.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Undefined.

Bitfield.Name: Order Execution Flags
Bitfield.Description: Order Execution flags. Bit 0 indicates SIP reportability; bit 1 indicates Traded Against Retail; bits 2-7 are reserved.

Field.Name: SIP Reporting
Field.Description: 0 - Not reportable to the SIP; 1 - Reportable to the SIP.

Field.Name: Traded Against Retail
Field.Description: 0 - Did not trade against Retail; 1 - Traded against Retail.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Bitfield.Name: Trade Flags
Bitfield.Description: Trade flags. Bit 0 indicates SIP reportability; bit 1 indicates Retail Trade participation; bits 2-7 are reserved.

Field.Name: SIP Reporting
Field.Description: 0 - Not reportable to the SIP; 1 - Reportable to the SIP.

Field.Name: Retail Trade Indicator
Field.Description: 0 - Neither side is Retail; 1 - At least one side is Retail.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.
